description: Today's trending Google searches for one country (public Google Trends RSS): rank, query, approximate search volume (e.g. '200+'), and the news items behind each trend. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
